fact: The Cabo Verde government and UN reported the Cadastro Social Unico reaching 64% of the population.
The Government of Cabo Verde says the Cadastro Social Unico is the base of the country's social support system and invites households in climate-vulnerable zones to register.

The Government of Cabo Verde says registered eligible households can access targeted support including cash transfers, food security support and resilience programmes through the Cadastro Social Unico.
The Cabo Verde minister says the Cadastro Social Único, implemented in 2017, is in use, with about 59% of households and 66% of the population classified and validated nationally.
The Cabo Verde minister says about 16 social programmes use the CSU to select beneficiaries, including RSI, social pension, higher-education grants and the social energy and water tariff.
